A single ember survived beneath the fallen gate. The realm began there.
The first master carved a mark into the stone so the next generation would know where to begin.
Every watchfire answers another beyond the trees.
The citadel was built from stones that remembered a brighter reign.
The crown was never gold. It was the promise to keep the light alive.
Ash takes the walls, not the stories told within them.

Old banners catch fire by themselves. Their embers can be gathered, or fed back to the crown.

An Ash Ritual resets buildings, mastery, seals, districts, marches, and current embers. Relic powers, crafted artifacts, outposts, Court victories, Chronicle looks, and your blueprint survive. Spend permanent relics to make the next reign stronger.

Reset: embers, buildings, mastery, seals, districts, and marches. Keep: relics and powers, artifacts, outposts, Court victories, cosmetics, and your blueprint. Choose permanent relic powers and a set on the Prestige screen before the next reign starts. Your gloom starts low again.
